correctness.rationale: Reconstructed sector dynamics F_j, polygon gauge and derivative rho′=−2λa(rho−1) in interiors, and exact two-sided ray fields. The zero transverse velocity constraint on positive-measure ray times forces the Filippov convex weight and z′=−λb² z−ω²/(λz), valid for |z|≥ω/(λa). These bounds integrate by Grönwall to global prefactor-one λb² contraction for every nonzero complete solution, no reaching origin, uniqueness of nonconstant period N/ω orbit; large-z sliding proves sharpness. Independently checked rational parameter algebra and logarithmic exit time for N=3,4,6,9; analytic piecewise absolute continuity handles unrestricted N.
